mapper.sql: ID, LIMIT_CODE, CONTRACT_ID, COMPANY_ID, FINANCING_INSTITUTION_ID, CREDIT_TYPE, TOTAL_LIMIT, USED_LIMIT, AVAILABLE_LIMIT, FROZEN_LIMIT, CURRENCY_CODE, EFFECTIVE_DATE, EXPIRY_DATE, INTEREST_RATE_TYPE, BASE_RATE, RATE_SPREAD, COMMITMENT_FEE_RATE, LIMIT_STATUS, LAST_USAGE_DATE, ORGID, CREATETIME, CREATEUSER, UPDATETIME, UPDATEUSER
mapper.select: WHERE CONTRACT_ID = #{contractId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
WHERE FINANCING_INSTITUTION_ID = #{financingInstitutionId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN LIMIT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeCount, SUM(TOTAL_LIMIT) AS totalLimitSum, SUM(USED_LIMIT) AS usedLimitSum, SUM(AVAILABLE_LIMIT) AS availableLimitSum, SUM(FROZEN_LIMIT) AS frozenLimitSum, ROUND(AVG(USED_LIMIT / TOTAL_LIMIT * 100), 2) AS avgUsageRatio FROM TBL_CREDIT_LIMIT WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}
SELECT LIMIT_STATUS AS status, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(TOTAL_LIMIT) AS totalAmount FROM TBL_CREDIT_LIMIT WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY LIMIT_STATUS
SELECT CREDIT_TYPE AS creditType, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(TOTAL_LIMIT) AS totalAmount, SUM(USED_LIMIT) AS usedAmount FROM TBL_CREDIT_LIMIT WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY CREDIT_TYPE

SELECT FINANCING_INSTITUTION_ID AS institutionId, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(TOTAL_LIMIT) AS totalAmount, SUM(USED_LIMIT) AS usedAmount FROM TBL_CREDIT_LIMIT WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY FINANCING_INSTITUTION_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_CREDIT_LIMIT SET USED_LIMIT = #{usedAmount}, AVAILABLE_LIMIT = #{availableAmount}, UPDATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{limitId}
UPDATE TBL_CREDIT_LIMIT SET LIMIT_STATUS = #{status}, UPDATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{limitId}
UPDATE TBL_CREDIT_LIMIT SET LIMIT_STATUS = 'EXPIRED', UPDATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EXPIRY_DATE < #{currentDate} AND LIMIT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(TOTAL_LIMIT) AS totalLimit, SUM(USED_LIMIT) AS usedLimit, SUM(AVAILABLE_LIMIT) AS availableLimit, SUM(FROZEN_LIMIT) AS frozenLimit FROM TBL_CREDIT_LIMIT WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} AND ORGID = #{orgId} AND LIMIT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
